title: Strait of Hormuz Traffic Drops to Lowest Level in Three Weeks
text:
Strait of Hormuz Traffic Drops to Lowest Level in Three Weeks"

"· Shipping transits through the Strait of Hormuz fell to 8 passages on July 16, marking the lowest level in the past three weeks."
"· Most traffic is now concentrated along the Iranian side of the waterway, and overall shipping activity continues to decline.
